sources.title: Jumia is cutting another 10% of staff. AI is the framing. Profitability is the deadline.
sources.description: Jumia is cutting another 10% of staff, citing AI workflows. The company has now shed more than half its workforce since 2022. Q4 profitability is the deadline.

sources.title: Jumia To Replace 200 Jobs With AI To Reach Profitability By End Of 2026
sources.description: Jumia plans to cut 200 jobs as AI replaces manual tasks across logistics & customer service, pushing the African e-tailer to profitability.

sources.title: Jumia to Replace 200 Employees With AI in Push Toward Profitability
sources.description: Jumia Technologies plans to cut about 200 full-time jobs, or 10% of its workforce, through AI-driven automation. The company aims to achieve positive cash flow by the fourth quarter of 2026 after years of restructuring and cost reductions.
